<!-- locale: en-gb | category: Support | section: Integration / General information on integrations | path: en-gb/Support/Integration/General-information-on-integrations/360002492898-Worktime-integrations.md | source: https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360002492898-Worktime-integrations -->

# Worktime integrations

[Standard integrations](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360002494538>) have been implemented between Nepton's work time records and other services. These integrations can be created as data files downloadable from the service, scheduled file transfers, or by using web service APIs. You can read more about the integrations [here](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360002489417>).
## Uploading standard format data in the user interface
Navigate to **Worktime** **> Administration > Integrations > Desired payroll system**
![etHNLmmMdn.png](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/28352927302557)
  1. Select the time range
  2. Select the levelling period time range if necessary  
  

  3. Select the **Ruleset** that defines the data to be extracted. It is not recommended to extract data without a selected ruleset, as this would prevent modifying the generated content. Integrations should be extracted using rulesets. You can read more about rule sets [here](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360002492278>).  
  

  4. Configure additional extraction settings  

     * Approved events are those that have been authorized - for example, a supervisor has approved the event. (The option 'Export only approved events' can be selected when no ruleset is selected. When a Ruleset is chosen, the extraction rules must define whether the events to be transferred must be approved.)
     * Lock events until the export end date means the dates will be locked up until the end of the selected time range. Note: If no data is generated based on the selections, the dates will not be locked.
  5. Email report to the following email addresses: The file will be sent to the selected email address. This field is optional. The email addresses used in the last transfer will be saved and used as default for the next one.  
  

  6. Send export data by SFTP: The file will be sent to the SFTP server defined either in the integration or in the selected ruleset settings. This field is optional.  

     * SFTP settings must already be configured
     * If a ruleset hasn't been chosen, the integration's SFTP settings are used.
     * If a ruleset if selected, that ruleset's SFTP settings are used.  
  

  7. Send export data by web service: Web service settings must be configured. This option must be selected when transferring data, for example, to Netvisor or from Nepton to another system via interface.
  8. Preview: Use this mode to perform a test run for review purposes only (no data will be transferred).
  9. Select the persons whose data will be included in the file.

<!-- locale: en-gb | category: Support | section: Reporting / Worktime reports | path: en-gb/Support/Reporting/Worktime-reports/360002548557-Worktime-reports.md | source: https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360002548557-Worktime-reports -->

# Worktime reports

This article has not been translated yet.
Events recorded by individuals and the resulting interpretation of working hours can be reported using several different standard reports available in the service. Below, some of the working hours reports and the data content they display are presented.
## Hours by salary type
The report displays interpreted hours by pay types (e.g., regular working hours, additional work, overtime). The report also shows the employee number, employee name, information entered in the report's additional information field, personell group, number of working days, number of annual leave days used, borrowed amount from accruals, on-call hours, as well as work allowances and increments. 
When generating the report, it is possible to choose whether the results are shown hourly or daily. If the information is presented hourly, the report shows the interpreted number of hours. If the information is presented daily, the report shows the number of days during the reporting period in which the result occurs.
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/25744439983005)
The report can be exported to Excel. In Excel, the balance is presented in decimal format. This allows the rows to be reliably sorted based on the balance.
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/25744439988125)
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/25744415667229)
## Realized work hours
The report shows a breakdown of working hours during the reporting period, working hours without absences, overtime, holidays equivalent to working hours, and time equivalent to working hours, as well as interpreted working hours based on recorded events on a daily basis for the reporting period.
Additionally, the report shows the average time equivalent to working hours per week, the number of absence days and working days, and the accrual balance at the end of the reporting period. Read more in the article [Realized work hours](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360016836978-Realized-work-hours>).
##  ![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/25744415669021)Hours by Event type
The report shows events recorded during the reporting period, categorized by reported event types. Additionally, the report displays the employee number, employee name, information entered in the report's additional information field, employee group, number of working days, number of public holidays, and number of annual leave days used.
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/25744415670045)
## **Filtering Individuals in Reports**
In hourly reports, it is possible to filter individuals in the following ways:
  * Based on groups (options include filtering by individual, payment, or setting group)
  * Based on subordinates of a specific supervisor
  * Based on subordinates of the person generating the report
  * Based on compensation (options include filtering by hourly or monthly salary)


You can find more information about filtering individuals in [here](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360004437597-Filtering-persons-in-worktime-and-project-reports>).

# Worktime roles

Person's worktime role gives permissions to see and edit information in the Work time section.
There is another role for viewing and editing person's information, as well as shift planning. More on this topic in [roles](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360002425637>).
See also: [Assigning roles](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360002553397>).
From service point of view, **admin user** has Administrator as role and All permissions as Worktime role.
In general, employees have narrower permissions than supervisors. Administrators have the most extensive permissions. There are few existing worktime roles in the service by default, but worktime roles can also be modified or completely new ones created. A person can have more than one worktime role at the same time.
Worktime roles can be viewed and edited in **Worktime > Administration > Worktime roles**.  
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/19334264959901)
Choose the worktime role you want to edit, then choose "worktime role permissions" as action.
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/31848137613469)
The worktime roles below can be found in the service by default. There might be other worktime roles established in your environment instead of or in addition to the ones below.
"**Kaikki oikeudet (All permissions)** " grants permission to lower, medium and high level rights.
"**Omien sekä alaisten tietojen muokkausoikeus (Permission to edit own and subordinates' data)** " gives the permission to edit the person's own and subordinate's data. This work time role usually has all the lower-level permissions, most of the medium-level permissions, and at least some of the higher-level permissions.
"**Omien tietojen katseluoikeus, alaisten muokkausoikeus (Permission to view own data, edit data of subordinates** " gives permission to see your own events and modify the events of subordinates. This worktime role can have very limited rights, i.e. people can only report hours using Current Status, mobile or terminal and add comments in the calendar. Or they may have most of the lower level rights and some of the medium-level rights.
## Worktime role permissions
The current permissions of worktime roles can be changed by selecting the desired rights from the list and then clicking Save. New worktime roles can also be created, and their permissions can be customized by selecting the wanted rights from the list. The permissions are divided into three different levels; lower level, medium level and higher level. Permissions can be given to a worktime role either one whole level at a time (by selecting 'All lower level rights' for example), or you can choose a permission to be granted from each level individually. What each permission does is explained in more detail below.

**Projects**  
Can report EU/ELY-centre project hours for managed projects | Persons with this permission can take EU/ELY-centre project report for their managed projects.  
Can create missing projects via terminal barcode reader | Persons with this permission can start an event with an attached project that will be automatically created if it does not already exist, using barcode readers with Nepton Flexim terminals.  
### High-level permissions
Title | Description  
---|---  
**Work hours**  
Can view events of all personnel | Persons with this permission can  _view_ (not edit) the events of _all_ persons in calendars and reports.  
Can view attachments in all events | Persons with this permission can  _view_ attached files in all persons' events.  
Can edit and approve all users events | Persons with this permission can create, edit and approve _all_ persons' events. It also grants the permission to approve event requests and set absence compensation (paid, reduced pay, unpaid). Grants the permission to edit work day length, work week length, permitted work times and expected work times.  
Can edit attachments in all events | Persons with this permission can  _view and_ _edit_ attached files in all persons' events.  
Can lock event dates |  Persons with this permission can lock event/calendar dates. Locked dates won't allow events to be added/edited or deleted unless the person doing the edit also has permission to unlock the dates. For the person to lock their _own_ calendar dates requires the medium level permission "Can approve personal events" (or higher equivalent permission) to also be set. For the person to lock events for other persons, they need permission to review and edit their calendars e.g. using "Can review subordinates entries" (or higher equivalent permission). ![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/19335314109597)  
Can unlock locked dates | Persons with this permission can unlock event/calendar dates that have been locked (for which persons depends on their other permissions, see previous permission for more details).  
Can administer annual leaves and their balances |  Persons with this permission can create/edit/delete events that change annual leave/holiday such as Annual leave earning reset and Annual leave earning change. _Note: To add these event types through the calendar they must also be activated in "Worktime settings > Work hours > Event types"_  
  
Can review all users annual leave reports | Persons with this permission can view all users (regardless of other permissions) in the annual leave reports.  
Can administer balances |  Persons with this permission can create/edit/delete events that change accrual values such as bank, balance etc. This includes all accruals except Annual leave which has a separate permission (see above). _Note: To add these event types through the calendar they must also be activated in "Worktime settings > Work hours > Event types"._  
Can define exceptions to own work obligation | Persons with this permission can change their own work day and work week obligations (lengths).  
Can set exceptions to own permitted work times | Persons with this permission can change their own permitted work times. Working outside of permitted work times is unpaid.  
Can edit all users dining events | Persons with this permission can view and edit the dining events for _all_ users.  
Can edit approved events | Persons with this permission can edit an event once it has been approved. They can only edit approved events from other persons if they have permission to view and edit their events in the first place.  
Can view external identifier of events | Persons with this permission can view external identifier of events.  
Can edit external identifier of events | Persons with this permission can edit external identifier of events.  
Can view salary information of all personnel | If displaying payslips is enabled in the calendar view, persons with this permission can view the payslips for all persons.   
**Shifts**  
Can edit shifts via API | Persons with this permission can create and edit shifts via API.  
**Sick Leave**  
Can view sick leave compensation of all personnel | Persons with this permission can view compensation (paid, unpaid...) of sick leaves for all persons.  
Can view medical certificates of all personnel | Persons with this permission can view medical certificate details (received, not received...) of sick leaves for all persons.  
Can edit sick leave compensation of all personnel | Persons with this permission can edit compensation (paid, unpaid...) of sick leaves for all persons.  
Can edit medical certificates of all personnel | Persons with this permission can edit medical certificate details (received, not received...) of sick leaves for all persons.  
**Projects**  
Can manage projects and project relations | Persons with this permission can add/edit/delete projects in the project administration, as well as add project managers to projects.  
Can report project events for all persons | Persons with this permission can report project events for _all_ persons.  
**Administration**  
Can manage persons' settings and projects | Persons with this permission can edit person settings, projects related to persons, and projects managed by the person.  
Can manage person groups | Persons with this permission can edit person group information, person group settings, persons related to the person group, and projects related to person groups.  
Can manage person setting groups | Persons with this permission can edit worktime setting group information, group settings. Note, also setting group members.  
Can manage Worktime roles | Persons with this permission can manage roles and permissions related to Worktime.**Important: this means that user effectively has all permissions listed on this page as they are able to set their own permissions and permissions of every other user.**  
Can take integration exports | Persons with this permission can use the "Administration > Integration" area to run imports and exports. **Important: this permission effectively grants persons ability to export and import data of any person(s).**

<!-- locale: en-gb | category: Support | section: FAQ | path: en-gb/Support/FAQ/16439727874717-Your-feedback-is-important-to-us.md | source: https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/16439727874717-Your-feedback-is-important-to-us -->

# Your feedback is important to us

We regularly gather feedback from users of the Nepton service. With feedback, we can ensure a smooth user experience for different user groups and develop our services.
The survey is displayed on the browser and mobile devices after the first work time entry of the day. Feedback is not collected on worktime terminals. Feedback is provided on a scale of 1-10, where 1 is the lowest rating and 10 is the highest. Additionally, you have the opportunity to provide open-ended feedback. If you don't want to answer the survey, it's easy and quick to skip it.
When giving a rating, we ask you to evaluate the service comprehensively based on, for example, the user experience of the service and the support you have recieved from your own organisation, Saarni Nepton or our partners.
Collected answers are treated confidentially. The role of each respondent (administrator, supervisor, employee, etc.) and the organization in the Nepton service is recorded in connection with the feedback. Both numerical and text-based feedback are used for the improvement of our services and for marketing communications.
Thank you for your time and for using our services.

# Customer support contact information

Trained administrator users have the right to contact Nepton customer service for free support. If you are not a trained administrator, please contact your supervisor or HR of your organization. We require administrators to go through [Bronze](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/5818304533917>) and [Silver](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/5820147293213>) level certification trainings in order to get free support from Customer Service. If your organization's contract partner is not Nepton, please contact your partner directly. 
Nepton support is available on weekdays from **08:00 to 16:00**. Email: **[support@nepton.com](<mailto:support@nepton.com>)** or phone: 03 311 929 29.
You can also send service request via [Nepton support pages.](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406611917841>)

# How to follow an article

You can subscribe to e-mail notifications from the support service for each article when they are updated.
**We recommend that all admin users follow at least the[Platform status](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360006554777>) and [Release notes](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360006615478>) pages.** The Platform status page informs about potential interruptions in the service, and the Platform status page about new features and updates released to Nepton.
Following articles requires that you have signed up and logged in to our support service. [In this article](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406611836817>), you can find instructions for signing up for Nepton Support.
Open the article you want to follow. Click the **Follow** button in the upper right corner. You can also unfollow from the same button.
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/23107098491549)

<!-- locale: en-gb | category: Support portal | section: How to use Nepton Support  | path: en-gb/Support-portal/How-to-use-Nepton-Support/4406611836817-How-to-register-and-login-to-Nepton-Support.md | source: https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406611836817-How-to-register-and-login-to-Nepton-Support -->

# How to register and login to Nepton Support

We recommend registering to our support portal, so you can [follow](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406604045585>) support articles. Also through the support portal you can [send](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406611917841>) and follow your Nepton [customer service](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/7077076926237>) requests, if you are the trained Nepton administrator of your organization. 
Note: Nepton Support credentials are separate from Nepton Service credentials. You need to create separate account for Nepton Support.
## How to register to Nepton Support
You can register as a support user by clicking [here](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/signin?return_to=https%3A%2F%2Fsupport.nepton.com%2Fhc%2Fen-gb%2Farticles%2F4406611836817-How-to-sign-up-and-login-to-Nepton-Support&locale=en-gb>). If you have previously contacted Nepton Customer Service by e-mail, click on the **Emailed us for support?** on the login page. If you have never contacted us before and would like to register as a new support service user, click **New to Nepton?**
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/20135949411101)
Follow the instructions to enter your name and email address. Then click **Sign up.**
![mceclip1.png](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/4407743919377)
You will then receive a confirmation email. Also check your spam folder and any other possible folders.
Follow the instructions in the email. After confirming your username, your account is ready to use. You can now log in to Nepton Support.
## How to register to Nepton Support as a partner
Follow the instructions above in section ''How to sign-up to Nepton Support.'' After you have successfully created an account, Nepton Admin can add a tag ''nepton_partner'' to your account details, which gives you more content in Nepton Support -page. 
## How to login to Nepton Support
Once you have credentials to Nepton support, you can login to Nepton Support by choosing Sign in from right corner of the page. 
![mceclip3.png](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/4409715283217)
Sign in by filling you Nepton Support credentials (email and password).
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/20135961318941)
The option ''Switch to agent sign-in'' is not available for customer use.

<!-- locale: en-gb | category: Support portal | section: How to use Nepton Support  | path: en-gb/Support-portal/How-to-use-Nepton-Support/4406611917841-How-to-send-service-requests-via-Nepton-Support.md | source: https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406611917841-How-to-send-service-requests-via-Nepton-Support -->

# How to send service requests via Nepton Support

**Trained administrators** in your organization can contact our [customer service](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/7077076926237>) via email or phone. We are happy to help with any questions.
If there is another party acting as the service provider for your organization, please contact the service provider's support service in all support matters in accordance with the instructions given to you.
Trained administrators can also send a support request directly through the support service. To send a support request, select **Create Support Request** from the menu at the top. The link is only visible to users [logged in](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406611836817>) to the Nepton Support service.
When you start typing in the **Subject*** field, the service provides any articles that are relevant to the topic. You can also open these articles at this point if any of them answer your question.
[This](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4419112526865>) article explains what should be taken into account when sending a support request to Nepton's customer service.
**![blobid0.jpg](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/4407748287633)**
After submitting your support request, you will receive a confirmation that the matter is being processed by customer service. Our customer service will respond to you as soon as possible. You will receive a reply to your email.
![blobid1.jpg](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/4407740986129)
To track your [own support requests](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4416596910353>), log in to the service and select your name at the top right and **My activities** from the drop-down menu. If you would like to update your support request, you can do so in the normal way via email.
![blobid2.jpg](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/4407740993297)

# Nepton Support portal overlook

Nepton Support instruction articles are divided by topic. All instructions related to how to use Nepton can be found on the front page:
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/23100017681181)
The instructions have been divided under four categories;  
-Support portal  
-Platform status and versions  
-Support  
-News and events
Support portal contains articles about using the Guide, for example how to register, search for articles and send support requests. Platform status and versions includes information about the current status of the service, as well as past and upcoming updates. Under support category, you can find all guidance related to using Nepton service. News and events category includes webinars and information about other public events.
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/23100017684893)
You can also search instructions by using the search function:
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/23100017688605)
The results are articles which topic contains the search word. If the drop-down menu does not offer a suitable article, you can press Enter to see more relative search results:
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/20118012657821)
We are constantly updating the Nepton Support articles and the search function. If you are a trained administrator in your organization and notice gaps or errors in the instructions, please let us know so that we can update the instructions.
We also recommend [registering](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406611836817>) to our support site. Once logged in, articles can also be [followed](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406604045585>). The perk of following an article comes in when the article is updated: you will get a notification to your email about the update immediately. In addition, trained administrators can send [support requests](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4406611917841>) from the support site directly to Nepton's customer service and [follow](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/4416596910353-Own-service-requests>) the status of requests.

# Own service requests

Persons logged in can view and update their own service requests in the support. The support requests sent from the email address you have registered with can be accessed in support through the option **My activities** \- menu.
## Viewing own support requests
1\. [Log in and register](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/fi/articles/4406611836817>) to support.
2\. Click on your own name at the top right corner **Your name > My activities.**
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/20137244239133)
On the following page you can see your open support requests.
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/20137244242461)
## Editing support requests
Support request is opened by clicking on it. You can make edits to the support requests by choosing **Add to conversation > Submit**.
![](https://support.nepton.com/hc/article_attachments/20137244243741)
## Viewing all support requests in your organization
If you want to see the support requests of the entire organization in the support service, regardless of who sent them, this possibility can be activated on your account. Please contact [customer service](<https://support.nepton.com/hc/en-gb/articles/7077076926237>) to enable the function.
